accepted.s: The inaugural State Energy Efficiency Preparedness Index was prepared by which of the following combinations?
o: NITI Aayog with the Bureau of Energy Efficiency
Bureau of Energy Efficiency with the Energy Efficiency Services Limited
Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change with NITI Aayog
Bureau of Energy Efficiency with the Alliance for an Energy Efficient Economy
accepted.x: The inaugural State Energy Efficiency Preparedness Index, introduced in 2018, was prepared by NITI Aayog in association with the Bureau of Energy Efficiency.
accepted.tq: Use the institution-pair distinction to avoid swapping agencies.
accepted.sec: Energy efficiency rankings → agency + AP position (SEEI, implementation readiness)

accepted.s:
With reference to the State Energy Efficiency Index (SEEI), consider the following statements:
1. The framework was developed by the Bureau of Energy Efficiency with the Alliance for an Energy Efficient Economy.
2. The SEEI framework forms the basis for the National Energy Conservation Awards.
3. The SEEI uses the categories Front Runner, Achiever, Contender and Aspirant.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
o: 1 and 2 only
2 and 3 only
1 and 3 only
1, 2 and 3
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. SEEI was developed by BEE with AEEE, is used as the basis for the National Energy Conservation Awards, and classifies States into four categories including Front Runner and Aspirant.
accepted.tq: Check each institutional, functional and classification statement separately.
accepted.sec: Energy efficiency rankings → agency + AP position (SEEI, implementation readiness)

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT a category used in the State Energy Efficiency Index?
o: Front Runner
Achiever
Innovator
Contender
accepted.x: The SEEI categories are Front Runner, Achiever, Contender and Aspirant. Innovator is not one of the stated categories.
accepted.tq: Find the one unfamiliar classification among the recognised category names.
accepted.sec: Energy efficiency rankings → agency + AP position (SEEI, implementation readiness)

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding energy conservation awards:
1. Chandigarh ranked first in the National Energy Conservation Award 2025.
2. The 2025 award ranking was given on the basis of the State Energy Efficiency Index.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
o: 1 and 2 only
1 and 3 only
2 and 3 only

accepted.tq: Separate the national ranking from the Andhra Pradesh institutional award.
accepted.sec: Energy efficiency rankings → agency + AP position (SEEI, implementation readiness)

accepted.s: Which one of the following lamps has the highest efficacy, longest life and no mercury?
o: Sodium vapour lamp
Incandescent lamp
Light-emitting diode lamp
Compact fluorescent lamp
accepted.x: LED lamps have the highest efficacy and longest life among the listed lamps and do not contain mercury.
accepted.tq: Identify the option carrying the complete energy-efficiency feature set.
accepted.sec: Energy-saving lighting - LED vs CFL vs sodium lamps, UJALA, SLNP

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched?
o: Sodium vapour lamp — white light and excellent colour rendering
Incandescent lamp — most energy lost as sound
CFL — contains mercury and has a shorter life than LED
LED — high mercury content and substantial heat production
accepted.x: CFLs are more efficient than incandescent lamps but contain mercury and have a shorter life than LEDs. Incandescent lamps mainly lose energy as heat, while sodium vapour lamps produce yellow light with poor colour rendering.
accepted.tq: Use feature-based elimination and watch for swapped lamp characteristics.
accepted.sec: Energy-saving lighting - LED vs CFL vs sodium lamps, UJALA, SLNP

accepted.s: Sodium vapour lamps are traditionally associated with which combination of characteristics?
o: White light, no heat loss and domestic lighting
Ultraviolet light, mercury-free operation and indoor lighting
Blue light, excellent colour rendering and very short life
Yellow light, poor colour rendering and street lighting
accepted.x: Sodium vapour lamps are used in street lighting and generally produce yellow light with poor colour rendering.
accepted.tq: Link the lamp type with its characteristic light colour and application.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the National Efficient Cooking Programme:
1. It is run by Energy Efficiency Services Limited.
2. It envisages 20 lakh induction cookstoves.
3. The induction cookstoves are stated to be 25–30 per cent cheaper than traditional cooking.
4. The programme is associated with MECS.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
o: 1 and 2 only
1, 2 and 3 only
2, 3 and 4 only
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. EESL runs the programme, which covers 20 lakh induction cookstoves, offers a stated 25–30% cost advantage over traditional cooking and is associated with MECS.
accepted.tq: Verify the agency, quantity, percentage and associated programme as separate components.

Consider the following statements regarding fuel-efficiency and conservation initiatives:
1. CAFE norms set average fuel-efficiency targets for M1 cars.

accepted.s: Which of the following sets contains only appropriate energy-conservation practices for lighting and appliances?
o: Replace LEDs with CFLs, avoid switching off appliances and use air conditioners continuously
Use unstarred appliances, leave chargers connected and operate appliances at maximum load
Use LEDs, choose star-rated appliances, switch off idle loads and avoid excessive use of air conditioners
Use incandescent bulbs, keep idle appliances on and increase air-conditioner use
accepted.x: LEDs, star-rated appliances, switching off idle loads and avoiding excessive air-conditioner use are the stated energy-conservation practices.
accepted.tq: Select the option in which every practice contributes to reducing energy use.

accepted.s: Which combination of practices is most suitable for reducing household energy use during cooking?
o: Use oversized burners, leave vessels uncovered and cook without pressure
Keep the flame wider than the vessel and avoid all forms of insulation
Use induction cookstoves, cover vessels with lids and use pressure cookers
Use incandescent heating elements and keep the cooker open throughout
accepted.x: Induction cooking, using lids and using pressure cookers are recommended practices for improving cooking efficiency.
accepted.tq: Choose the option containing only efficiency-enhancing practices.
accepted.sec: Everyday energy conservation practices - cooking, driving, appliances, sustainability link

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT included among the stated fuel-saving driving practices?
o: Maintaining correct tyre pressure
Driving at a steady speed
Keeping the engine running at every traffic signal
Switching off the engine at signals
accepted.x: Correct tyre pressure, steady speed and switching off the engine at signals are fuel-saving practices. Keeping the engine running at every signal is contrary to the stated advice.
accepted.tq: Find the reversed driving practice among otherwise practical conservation measures.
